name: branch
assembly:
mov rax,rdi
add rax,rsi
jc carry
jz zero
ret
carry: mov rax,-1
ret
zero: mov rax,77
ret

name: shift
assembly:
mov rax,rdi
mov rcx,rsi
rol rax,cl
xor rax,rsi
ret

name: memory
assembly:
mov rax,[rdi]
xor rax,rsi
mov [rdi+8],rax
ret

name: call
assembly:
call callee
add rax,3
ret
.p2align 4
callee: lea rax,[rdi+rsi*2]
ret

name: indirect
assembly:
call rsi
add rax,5
ret
.p2align 4
callee: lea rax,[rdi+9]
ret

name: avx
assembly:
vmovq xmm0,rdi
vmovq xmm1,rsi
vpxor xmm2,xmm0,xmm1
vmovq rax,xmm2
vzeroupper
ret

name: tls
assembly:
mov rax,qword ptr fs:[0]
add rax,rsi
ret
